title: David Delivers Keilah
reflectionText: David faced one danger while rescuing Keilah and another after the city was saved. He asked for guidance before the battle, asked again when his men were afraid, and asked again when Saul approached. What do these repeated questions invite you to notice when safety remains uncertain?
editorialNotes: Packet 020 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling stays within 1 Samuel 23:1-14 and presents Keilah’s predicted surrender as divine warning, not as a betrayal that occurred.
